text:
OpenAI says it parted ways with three safety researchers over mishandling sensitive company information, per the WSJ. They reportedly shared details with an outside AI-safety group. OpenAI says its probe found no compromise. That is the company's account; their side unreported.

Source: OpenAI spokesperson statement via WSJ, Oct 1
